description: This file defines an abstract class `TimesheetPeriod` within the `OrangeHRM	ime	imesheetperiod` namespace, representing a base for different timesheet period implementations in the OrangeHRM project. It includes abstract methods for setting the timesheet period and calculating days within the period.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriod
classes.description: An abstract base class for different timesheet period implementations in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Abstract method to set the timesheet period starting from a given day.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate days within the timesheet period based on the current date and xml data.
